paragraphs: This repository publishes a built snapshot from the source repository, source commit b39726aaa0678a239602a9fb3a5fc434ab6ff8b4, merged through PR #41. Source/version metadata is also in deployment.json and app/version.json. The site and app ship in one Pages artifact; the existing root publishing path also remains usable.

This is a review checkpoint, not full V3 completion. The cutover report lists remaining work and tests. Official-source import returned HTTP 400, so Add parts remains the fallback. One combined production meeting-workflow migration was rejected by automatic review and remains unapplied. SFTS and confirmed-report endpoints were applied with authenticated-only privileges.

The supplied form reference files are excluded. Layouts are independently drawn. Examples are fictional. Application code is All rights reserved; bundled third-party packages and fonts retain their respective licenses. No end-to-end encryption claim is made. The assistant is a deterministic on-device parser; confirmed records use the normal backend.
